_comment_epi_reference_n4: N4-correct a reference copy before spatial registration; keep the original MC target and incoming BOLD intensities.
_comment: Realtime defaults for Olga's PFC presence/absence DecNef session. Derived from the lab template; deviations are annotated below.
_comment_json: JSON does not support native comments, so this file uses _comment fields for inline notes.
_comment_timing: Acquisition/model settings. analysis_space: epi (selected EPI reference), t1 (T1), or mni (MNI). Spatial transforms and optional smoothing precede original-intensity cGLM and voxel normalization, both on the final analysis grid.
_comment_voxel_normalization: zscore: center and divide by sample SD of denoised final-grid voxels; mean: 100 * denoised value / pre-GLM mean after transforms and optional smoothing. The first successful cGLM fit seeds z-scoring from stored startup residual history: fixed takes the first N valid fitted rows; running takes all available fitted rows and then updates from prior samples only. Scoring starts on the next TR, without a second calibration window. With N=30 and a first fit at volume 30, the earliest scored volume is 31; design or coverage can delay readiness.
_comment_masks: Mask-based nuisance regressors. GS often removed to avoid over-correcting global signal.
_comment_censor: dvars_warmup (20) < skip_first_trs + baseline (40), so DVARS statistics are established before the first trial. FD threshold 0.3 mm is standard; censored volumes still get scored, they are only flagged in the regression.
_comment_biopac: BIOPAC/RETROTS receiver defaults. Override per run with CLI if needed.
_comment_truncate: This uses only the voxels allowed in EPI for transformations
_comment_fieldmap: Fieldmap correction settings for realtime unwarping (PyHySCO PED is derived from epi_phase_encoding).
_comment_resampler: New way to apply transforms using our own written CUDE script
_comment_baseline_sync: voxel_norm_ref_volumes independently sets the statistical window. --baseline-trs controls presentation timing and does not override it or extend automatically. The first successful cGLM fit also seeds z-score calibration from stored history; scoring can start on the next TR once sufficient valid data exist. Increase --baseline-trs explicitly if a longer background period is wanted.
_comment_skip_sync: Keep skip_first_trs consistent with the resolved --skip-first-trs launcher setting; these discarded initial volumes do not replace the GLM or normalization calibration.
_comment_scoring: The pipeline applies transforms, optional smoothing, denoising, then voxel normalization on the final analysis grid. The probability launcher must score these features without a second voxel z-score. The fixed startup reference differs from offline run-wise standardization: compare the trained decoder feature contract before reusing its weights. Supply --decoder-roi-txt to include the trained intercept.
_comment_workers: Raised from 2. TR=1s with T1-space resampling and a 5-stage trial structure leaves little slack; verify the per-volume latency in the run log stays under 1.0 s and drop back to 2 if the GPU resampler is contended.
_comment_gs: Changed from false to TRUE. The offline decoder was trained on data cleaned with global_signal, csf and white_matter as confounds (mvpa_pfc.config.DEFAULT_MOTION_COLS). Any regressor present offline but absent online leaves its variance in the real-time features, where the weights treat it as signal. use_wm/use_vent were already true; global signal was the one gap.
